_about: Homepage settings per deck folder, read by build-index.mjs and build-home-covers.mjs. Text: title, subtitle, event, meta (place and date) override what the deck's title slide says; set subtitle, event or meta to null to hide it (a title cannot be hidden and falls back to the folder name). date: ISO date of the talk, used for ordering and the year heading (otherwise the folder name). Published decks are frozen, so their homepage text is corrected here, not in the deck. cover: a designed 960 x 720 page (html, e.g. scripts/covers/*.html, path from the repo root) or an image inside the deck (src), cropped to 4:3 like CSS object-position (position, default centre), optionally enlarged (zoom); false for no cover; without a cover setting the title slide is used. A talk given more than once (same title and subtitle) shows the cover of its most recent deck. Run npm run build:covers after changing a cover.
